title: Photograph your report
subtitle: We read your screening report, explain each finding in plain words and read it aloud.
unverified: From your photo, not yet confirmed by your screening centre
privacy: Your photo is used only to read your report and is deleted straight away.

explain.title: Your report, explained
explain.specialistTitle: A genetic counsellor will explain this
explain.specialistBody: Some results, such as uncertain or complex findings, need a specialist to explain them. GeneBridge doesn't show an explanation for them. A counsellor will go through everything with you, in your language.
explain.notDetectedBody: No changes found. This lowers the chance a lot, but no test can rule out every change.
explain.beadsLabel: Your two copies of this gene: one typical, one changed
explain.notDiagnosis: A carrier result is not a diagnosis
explain.saved: Saved. Your results show these findings, labelled as from your photo.
explain.saveError: Your results couldn't be saved. Please try again.
explain.cantSave: Reports for someone else can't be saved to your results. They can scan it in their own account.
explain.leaveNote: If you leave without saving, nothing is kept.
explain.ask: Ask a question about this report
